extracted.name: Black Beans, Corn, and Yellow Rice
extracted.description: Make a meal out of a package of yellow rice by adding black beans, corn, and lime juice.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15.25 ounce) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
instruction_lines: Bring water, rice, and olive oil to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice tender, and liquid absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes.
Combine corn, black beans, lime juice, and cumin in a large bowl; stir in rice and serve.
